children: NVIDIA Corporation (NASDAQ:NVDA) posted record $86B revenue and massive growth guidance while striking deals—from a $12.9B Hugging Face buy to GPU supply and financing pacts with Nscale, Lambda, SB Energy and MediaTek—amid U.S. export curbs and claims of GPT-6 AGI readiness.
Previous Week Recap
NVIDIA Revenue Guidance Jump
: NVIDIA (NVDA) posted $86B revenue (+106% YoY) and guided ~ $108B next quarter. Management forecasts ~77% revenue growth next fiscal year (about 70% for calendar 2027).
NVIDIA To Buy Hugging Face
: NVIDIA agreed to buy Hugging Face for about $12.9B. Deal faces regulatory approval and aims to close H1 2027. Hugging Face reports ~18M developers, 3M models, 500K datasets.
Export Controls On AI Chips
: U.S. rules bar NVIDIA (NVDA) from exporting its top AI chips to China, while sales of its robotics and automotive chips remain allowed under current controls.
Vera Rubin GPUs For Barstow
: NVIDIA to supply Vera Rubin GPUs to Nscale’s Barstow data center from H2 2027, initial contract $3.5B, potential >$6B, capacity up to 100,000 GPUs — supports Anthropic cloud deal.
Banks Mobilize AI Capital
: NVIDIA (NVDA) said it’s working with major banks to mobilize over $500 billion in third-party capital to fund AI infrastructure investments.
MediaTek Bonds And NVLink
: NVIDIA bought $3.5B of MediaTek convertible bonds (~3.6% of recent quarterly sales) as part of a partnership to integrate NVLink Fusion, XPUs, rack-scale AI, and automotive solutions.
Lambda Becomes Anthropic Partner
: NVIDIA (NVDA) supplies GPUs for Lambda’s new Texas data center at Hut 8’s Beacon Point. Lambda signed a $35B deal with Anthropic. Hut 8 expands ~350 MW capacity; financing and utilization tracked.
SB Energy Nasdaq Listing
: SB Energy seeks Nasdaq listing to fund an Ohio AI data-center. NVDA agreed to invest $3B and to assume the lease if OpenAI defaults; OpenAI leased the project.
GPT-6 Astra AGI Claim
: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang said OpenAI’s GPT‑6 Astra marks AGI and was trained on over 100,000 NVIDIA Grace/NVLink systems; he added 400,000 more NVIDIA GPUs are expected online.
Rubin CPX Rack Upgrade
: NVIDIA NVDA: Rubin CPX now uses a standalone MGX ETL rack. Configs: 64/128/192/256 CPX GPUs. Each 64-GPU module has eight trays of eight CPX GPUs linked by NVLink; Ethernet links trays/racks.
